_comment: Copy this file to ad_config.json and paste your real AdMob ad unit IDs. ad_config.json is gitignored so your IDs never end up in source control. Build with: flutter build appbundle --release --dart-define-from-file=ad_config.json
_note_app_id: The AdMob APP ID (the one with a ~) does NOT go here. It belongs in android/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml.
